source.title: Elon Musk: AI will be smarter than any human around the end of next year

items.test: Right if, by the end of April 2026, at least one AI system is credibly shown, by independent evaluation rather than its maker's claims, to be smarter than the smartest human across essentially all intellectual work; partly if AI clearly out-performs the best human experts in several major fields but not across the board.
items.finding: By the end of April 2026 no AI system had been shown to be smarter than the smartest human across the board. Stanford's 2026 AI Index found frontier models meeting or exceeding human baselines on PhD-level science questions, multimodal reasoning and competition mathematics, while the top model read analogue clocks correctly only 50.1% of the time. In January 2026 Musk himself said AI smarter than any human might arrive by the end of 2026.

evidence.title: Elon Musk Predicts AI Will Outpace Human Intelligence as Early as This Year

items.test: Right if, by the end of September 2026, OpenAI has a system that carries out AI research tasks that would take a researcher a few days, under human direction, as shown by OpenAI's disclosures or independent evaluation; partly if it handles only tasks of hours by then.
items.finding: On 6 September 2026 OpenAI said that, by its own measurements, it had reached the goal of an automated research intern: a system that carries out well-defined research tasks under human direction, including tasks that would take a skilled researcher a few days. The claim rests on OpenAI's own measurements; no independent evaluation has been published.

evidence.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
